**[@fig-validation]** | **[Concordance of AGES effect sizes with published blood EWAS of Alzheimer's disease.]{.rev}** Effect sizes from the AGES cohort were compared with those from [two published resources covering three cohorts]{.rev} across three dementia phenotypes: normal2incid, mci2incid, and prevalent dementia (prev). [Each axis shows its own study's effect measure: for AGES, the effect size (ΔM), the covariate-adjusted difference in mean M-value between each group and the stable normal group; for the ADNI/AIBL meta-analysis, the log~2~ odds ratio of Alzheimer's disease per 0.01 increase in methylation beta value; and for AddNeuroMed, the difference in mean methylation beta value between diagnostic groups after adjustment for age, sex, cell-type proportions and bisulfite-conversion batch. Because these measures are on different scales, agreement was assessed only by rank correlation and by direction of effect.]{.rev} **A,** Spearman correlation of effect sizes between AGES and a meta-analysis of the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) and Australian Imaging, Biomarkers, and Lifestyle (AIBL) cohorts. CpG sites were selected at two significance thresholds (*P* < [1.0 ×]{.rev} 10^−4.5^ and *P* < [1.0 ×]{.rev} 10^−4^) based on the ADNI/AIBL meta-analysis, with the number of overlapping sites indicated for each comparison [(before trimming)]{.rev} and the number of [participants]{.rev} indicated for each cohort. **B,** Correlation of effect sizes between AGES and the AddNeuroMed cohort for comparisons of controls versus MCI (top row) and controls versus AD (bottom row). [The analysis used the 931 of the 1,000 top-ranked CpG sites published by the AddNeuroMed study (ANOVA of control, MCI and AD groups) that were among the AGES CpG sites.]{.rev} **C,** [Sign concordance between AGES and the ADNI/AIBL meta-analysis at six meta-analysis *P*-value thresholds, shown as −log~10~ *P* of a one-sided exact binomial test of whether more than half of the CpG sites had the same direction of effect in both studies.]{.rev} Colors indicate AGES phenotypes: normal2incid (green), mci2incid (orange), and prev (purple). The dashed horizontal line indicates *P* = 0.05 for the binomial test. **D,** [The same test for the AddNeuroMed AD-versus-control (green) and MCI-versus-control (orange) comparisons.]{.rev} In **A** and **B**, blue lines indicate linear regression fits, and Spearman correlation coefficients (*r*) with corresponding [*P* values]{.rev} are displayed in red. [CpG sites outside the central 95% of either study's effect sizes (2.5% trimmed from each tail on each axis, separately for each comparison and threshold) were excluded; panels **A** and **B** show the remaining sites, and all correlations and sign tests were computed on them.]{.rev}
